name: Kemonomichi -Roku-
source:
This is the 6th volume of the "Kemonomichi" series! 
This volume focuses on the magic thunder soldier with multiple endings. 
Out of the blue, an unusual incident happened...
Her love love appears and plays a clever trick on the magic soldier....
Under threat, the heroine has no choice but to spread her legs for masked man... 

Can she find a way out of this critical situation, or...!? 

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088896.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
这是《兽之道》系列第6卷！
本卷主要讲述具有多重结局的魔雷兵。
没想到，一件不寻常的事情发生了……
她的爱人出现，对神兵耍了一个巧妙的诡计……
女主角迫于威胁，无奈为蒙面人张开双腿…… 

她能否找到摆脱困境的出路，或者……！？

[来自[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE088896.html]DLsite英文[/url]]
